title: Graph Compute Segfault Debug
summary: Graph compute segfault root cause: signal handler + backtrace_symbols_fd with STDERR_FILENO interfered with GGML CPU backend signal handling. Kernel and tensor wiring were correct. Fix: clean test pattern without signal handler tricks.

investigation: Tensor data pointers confirmed valid after allocation
21B-R unit test PASSED (same kernel + tensor setup)
Clean check test PASSED when signal handler removed
root_cause.root_cause: Signal handler + backtrace_symbols_fd(STDERR_FILENO) interfered with GGML CPU backend's internal signal handling for threading
was_not_the_problem: Op arity (3 sources: src0=X, src1=W, src2=scales)

native_behavior.when_off: uses build_lora_mm(up, cur) - native FFN_UP unchanged

test_pattern.key_insight: Use fresh ggml_context + ggml_backend_cpu_init per test
test_pattern.allocation_order: Create tensors (including result) → ggml_backend_alloc_ctx_tensors → ggml_backend_tensor_set → build graph → compute
test_pattern.avoid: Signal handlers that override SIGSEGV during GGML compute
